notes.title: Agentic observability: what leaders should require before agents reach production
notes.summary: Agents turn one request into a tree of decisions, model calls and tool calls. The OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions give that tree a shared vocabulary. Eight requirements to adopt.

notes.title: Test triangulation: properties that say what must never happen
notes.summary: Example tests check only the cases an engineer thought of. Triangulate: state the properties that constrain the behaviour, including what must never happen, and let a framework try thousands of inputs to find a counterexample. Then map the value stream to see where late defects cost time.

notes.title: Eval-driven development: from production traces to the release gate
notes.summary: Evals make an LLM system's limits explicit. Eval-driven development treats them as test-driven development treats tests: watch behaviour through telemetry, turn each failure into a failing eval, gate every change module by module against a baseline, and send what fails back to engineers.
